description: Traffic Commissioner public inquiries listed for companies (date, time, venue, legal grounds and the official notice), from the weekly Applications and Decisions and Notices and Proceedings, optionally for one traffic area. Inquiries for sole traders and partnerships are counted, not named. Being called to an inquiry is not a finding against the operator.

area.description: Traffic area: slug (e.g. 'scotland', 'north-west-of-england'), letter (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M) or name

attribution.description: Attribution text to show with the data

code.description: Traffic area letter, the second letter of the licence number (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M)

counted_not_listed.description: Upcoming inquiries for sole traders, partnerships or unnamed applicants: counted only

grounds.description: Legislation the inquiry is called under, as published

publication.description: Traffic Commissioner publication (Applications and Decisions, or Notices and Proceedings)

file_date.description: Date of the DVSA operator licence file the data describes (null before the first import)
